title: VoiceBot AI
summary: A personal project: a voice assistant that transcribes speech, answers from a resume-based persona and replies in text and audio.
overview: An interactive voice-based assistant. Users speak or pick predefined questions; the app transcribes the audio, generates an answer and returns it as text and playable audio.
problem: Conversations are more natural by voice. This project connects speech-to-text, a language model and text-to-speech in one web interface.
approach: AssemblyAI provides speech-to-text, with a fallback to Google Speech Recognition.
Azure OpenAI generates answers; responses are based on a provided resume text.
Responses are converted to audio and played back in the browser.
A responsive web interface shows the conversation in real time.

architecture.label: Speech services
architecture.detail: AssemblyAI for transcription (Google Speech Recognition fallback) and text-to-speech for audio replies.

architecture.label: Language model
architecture.detail: Azure OpenAI, answering from a resume-based persona.

workflow.step: The user records audio or selects a predefined question.
The model answers from the resume text and the reply is returned as text and audio.

items: Built this personal project, per the public repository.

limitations: Details come from the project's public README on GitHub; no usage numbers, accuracy figures or deployment results are claimed.
